date_last_updated.why: Clearing 2026-08-02 is correct: it is a partial commencement date, not an amendment.

date_in_force.why: The quote is the Gazette supplement date, which shows publication; the text itself defers only regulations 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 and 10 to 2 August 2026 (reg. 1(3)) and the ELI metadata gives 10 October 2025 as first entry into force. The value is right, but the quote alone does not state it.

language.why: The Maltese-language file at legislation.mt has the same SHA-256 (b42da6592d99) as the English PDF, so the legal notice exists in English only.

summary_claims.claim: Penalty on a public authority or body capped at EUR 50,000 per infringement plus EUR 50 a day; Regulation 12 adds the regulations to the Second Schedule to the Administrative Justice Act
Regulations 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 and 10 come into force on 2 August 2026

note: Legal notice PDF and ELI page confirm L.N. 226 of 2025, Gazette supplement 21,519 of 10 October 2025 and the deferred commencement. The deferred regulations took effect on 2 August 2026, which has passed, so 'In force' stands. A search found no 2026 amendment.
